title: Estimates of the Hubble constant, 1927–2022
description: Bar chart. Estimates of the Hubble constant in kilometres per second per megaparsec. Lemaître (1927): 625. Hubble (1929): 500. Humason, Mayall and Sandage (1956): 180. Sandage (1958): about 75. Planck, from the microwave background (2018): 67.4. SH0ES, from Cepheids and supernovae (2022): 73.0. Data: the table of estimates in Wikipedia's Hubble's law, revision 1376040730; Hubble, PNAS 15 (1929): 168–173.
heading: HUBBLE CONSTANT · KM/S PER MEGAPARSEC
